eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥19 years
* Persistent atrial fibrillation
* H2FPEF score ≥6 or HFA-PEFF score ≥5
* Restoration of sinus rhythm after electrical cardioversion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous use of an SGLT2 inhibitor
* Intracardiac thrombus on transesophageal echocardiography
* Refusal to participate

identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Impact of SGLT2 Inhibitor After DC Cardioversion in Persistent AF With HFpEF
